subject: Quick questions before scheduling: Hippo AI demo (volume, concurrency, SSO)
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@hippo.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Mar 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick questions before scheduling: Hippo AI demo (volume, concurrency, SSO)

Hi Samir —

Thanks for signing up to try Redwood. I pulled your intake (thanks for the quick form) and before I lock in a demo with one of our solutions engineers I have a few short clarifying questions so we tailor the session to Hippo AI’s needs:

• Primary use case you want Redwood for (chat assistants, summarization, reranking, embeddings + search)?
• Expected monthly token/API calls or messages (ballpark is fine) and any anticipated ramp over 6–12 months
• Peak concurrency (peak requests per second or concurrent sessions) — important for sizing
• Typical prompt/sequence length (short queries vs 2–3k token prompts)
• Timeline: PoC/POC start, pilot, go-live target?
• Any compliance/SSO/KMS requirements we should know about?
• Integrations: real-time REST inference vs batch/async (or both)?

I attached a tiny CSV template (traffic_template.csv) you can drop numbers into if that’s easier. If you prefer, share a quick note here and I’ll propose 3 slot options (30 min).

Looking forward — we’ll make the demo technical but time-efficient.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Senior SDR | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment: traffic_template.csv (CSV)
From: Samir Patel <samir@hippo.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Mar 2027 00:48:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Quick questions before scheduling: Hippo AI demo (volume, concurrency, SSO)

Hi Naomi — thanks for the note and the template. Answers below (happy to attach a quick export if that helps):

• Use case: real-time customer support assistant + post-chat summarization for analytics.
• Monthly volume: ~1.2M API calls today (mostly short messages), expected to ramp to ~4–5M/month in 9–12 months as we roll out new channels.
• Peak concurrency: around 55 qps today; expect bursts to 150–200 qps during promos.
• Typical prompt size: median ~120 tokens; 95th percentile ~1,200 tokens when including context and conversation history.
• Timeline: pilot in June, pilot -> production by Q4 depending on perf and cost.
• Compliance: we need SOC2-type evidence; will want SSO (SAML) and KMS for key management at production.
• Integration: primarily real-time REST inference; we may also batch embeddings for analytics.

I attached a small export (traffic_export_Mar.csv) with hourly volumes for the past week.

We prefer 30 minutes for the first call — timezone is PST. Available windows this week: Wed 09:30–11:00 PT, Thu 13:00–16:00 PT, Fri 08:00–09:30 PT.

—Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Machine Learning | Hippo AI
samir@hippo.ai
+1 (650) 555-1212

Attachment: traffic_export_Mar.csv (CSV)
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 22 Mar 2027 08:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick questions before scheduling: Hippo AI demo (volume, concurrency, SSO)

Great, this is very helpful — thanks for the detail and the CSV. A couple quick follow-ups so Ben (solutions engineer) and I can scope the demo correctly:

• For \"peak concurrency\" — is 150–200 qps a sustained multi-minute burst or very short spikes (seconds)?
• For the 1,200 token case: is that mostly context carried forward (KV cacheable) or unique prompt content per request?

Ben will join the demo to run through latency/throughput expectations and integration patterns. I attached a short one-pager on Redwood so you have it ahead of the call.

If Wed 10:00 PT works we can book a 30-min slot and keep it focused: 1) quick infra/cost sizing 2) demo of real-time inference and caching 3) next steps for a pilot. If you prefer another time from your list let me know.

Thanks — looping Ben in.
Naomi
Senior SDR | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com

Attachment: redwood_onepager.pdf (PDF)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 22 Mar 2027 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick questions before scheduling: Hippo AI demo (volume, concurrency, SSO)

Hi Samir — Ben here, thanks for the context. I’ll prepare a quick sizing slide (sustained vs burst cost estimates) and a short agenda:
1) 10 min: architecture + routing/caching options for conversational context
2) 10 min: live demo with a sample prompt (we'll use a sanitized snippet from your CSV if you confirm)
3) 10 min: pilot next steps (SAML onboarding, KMS, and expected timelines)

If you can confirm whether the 150–200 qps is sustained (minutes) vs short spikes (seconds) that will change our autoscaling guidance. Also confirm if we should include a quick GPU cost estimate for the 95th percentile prompt size.

I’ll join Wed 10:00 PT if that’s confirmed.
–Ben

Subject: Re: Quick questions before scheduling: Hippo AI demo (volume, concurrency, SSO)

Naomi, Ben — Wed 10:00 PT works for us. Quick note: the 150–200 qps is usually short bursts (30–90s) tied to marketing spikes, not sustained minutes. The 1,200 token requests are mostly unique prompt content (we can't rely on heavy caching in that slice).

We can keep this to 30 minutes. Please send a Google Meet link and we'll join. Looking forward.

Samir
Head of ML | Hippo AI
